title: Infrastructure-as-Code Control Plane & Docker Provider Engine
description: Refactors the Go control plane server and implements the Docker API container provider for dynamic app provisioning, resource limit manifests, and staging URLs.
keyDecisions: DOCKER ENGINE API OVER KUBERNETES. Community applications require minimal overhead and instant spin-up. Docker API via Go exec/SDK provides maximum compatibility and ultra-low resource footprint for VPS hosting.
EXPLICIT RAM & CPU MANIFESTS. Every app manifest requires explicit memory (MemoryMB) and CPU limits (CPULimit) to ensure zero hidden charges or unpredictable scaling.
